title: Safer shared roster recovery
summary: Protects the loaded roster during failed refreshes and makes save conflicts clearer.
changes: Rejects older or incomplete shared snapshots before they can replace staffing or allocations.
Keeps the last loaded roster visible and read-only when a refresh fails.
Prevents late roster responses from restoring private data after sign-out or access changes.
Verifies timed-out saves only against a successful online refresh and preserves safe retry identifiers.
Shows the affected night's changes after a save conflict and explains when the latest roster could not be loaded.
